card.name: Handling warnings about breaking or dropping
card.fires_on: The word right after a handling warning starts, such as "Do not" or "Never" before break, crush, push or wash. Also "a" after "dropped on" before a hard surface.

modes.label: The Do not / Never wording before a handling verb
modes.description: Negation word in an instruction not to break, crush, push or wash a tablet or device.
modes.example: Do<< not>> push the ODT through the foil.

modes.label: Dropped on a hard surface
modes.description: The article after "dropped on" in injector or syringe instructions.
modes.example: use the NUCALA prefilled autoinjector or prefilled syringe if dropped on<< a>> hard surface.

modes.label: Linking word in condition lists
modes.description: A comma, "is" or "or" inside a condition about a broken tablet or a patient's state.
modes.example: Advise patients not to ingest a tablet if it<< is>> broken, cracked, or not otherwise intact

card.writes: It leans toward words like rough and dirty, suggesting wording about physical condition or handling of items.
card.plain: It marks warnings about not breaking, crushing or dropping a tablet or device.
